notes: §2002:12.3.4.5.3 GR1: the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause specifies an alternate record key for the file. l1_read_key_of_reference declares ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS R-ALT over records 01/DD 02/CC 03/BB 04/AA; 'MOVE "CC" TO R-ALT / READ F KEY IS R-ALT' prints A1=00 02/CC (the record found by its alternate key), and the following READ NEXT gives A2=00 01/DD and A3-ATEND=10 (ascending on the alternate key of reference, §2002:9.1.8.1), opposite to prime order. l1_read_key_of_reference run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: PASS.
